# customdomain-sdk

> Official JavaScript and TypeScript client packages for CustomDomain™ (customdomain.ai): let SaaS
> users connect their own custom domain (for example `acme.com` instead of `acme.yourapp.com`)
> with DNS records written for them, domain verification, and TLS certificate issuance.

This repository contains the public browser clients only (backend and infrastructure are a
separate private repository). Two packages publish to npm in lockstep, currently at 0.5.0:
`customdomain-js` (framework agnostic SDK, exposes `window.customdomain`) and `@customdomain/react`
(React hook and component bindings around the SDK). Both open an embeddable widget that a SaaS
application mounts so its end users can connect a domain without manual DNS work. Of 63 catalogued
DNS providers, 25 have an automatic write path (scoped API token, provider OAuth, or Domain
Connect); the rest use a guided manual flow with automatic verification. Record writes,
verification and ACME certificate issuance happen server side.

## SDK reference

- [customdomain-js README](packages/sdk/README.md): install, quickstart, the `window.customdomain`
  methods (`open(config)`, `checkDomain(domain, { token })`, `checkRecords(domain, { token,
  dnsRecords })`, `purchaseDomain(config)`, `loadSharedFlow(url)`, `load()`, `close()`), the
  options (including `getToken` for silent widget token refresh and `wwwRedirect` for root
  domains), and the window events `customdomain:success`, `customdomain:close`,
  `customdomain:step`, `customdomain:error`, `customdomain:fallback`, `customdomain:purchase`,
  `customdomain:shared`, `customdomain:request-close`, `customdomain:doc-click`. Includes a
  `window.entri` compatibility shim for drop-in migration.
- [@customdomain/react README](packages/react/README.md): the `useCustomdomain()` hook and
  `<CustomdomainConnect>` component, the callback-prop-to-window-event mapping, and selling
  domains with `purchaseDomain()` and `onPurchase`.
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): every published version, what changed, and the commit it was built from.
- [CustomDomain™ documentation](https://docs.customdomain.ai/docs): the server side API (minting
  widget tokens with `POST /v1/tokens`, webhooks, per-provider DNS behavior) and the full
  [widget and SDK reference](https://docs.customdomain.ai/docs/widget-sdk/reference).

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/CUSTOM-DOMAIN-APP/customdomain-sdk): source, CI
  (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`), and the provenance-signed release workflow
  (`.github/workflows/release.yml`) for both packages.
